thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate (p99 ~ 3.2s, baseline 600ms). Auto-page sent to #oncall. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/alerts/3109991234
oncall-sre: Got the page, looking now. Jumping into metrics.
sre-lead: Noted. Any customer-facing errors?
prod-support: No 5xxs in logs, just slow responses. A couple of support tickets mentioning timeouts from EU region.
eng-runtime: Opening live tail for affected pods. Sequence length looks normal, traffic spike around 20% above baseline.
oncall-sre: CPU on gpus slightly elevated, KV cache hit rate dropped from 95% -> 62% at spike start. Could be cache churn.
eng-runtime: Reproduced KV eviction pattern. Prefetch worker restart at 09:12 UTC correlated with drop.
sre-lead: Quick mitigation options: 1) route EU traffic to fallback variant with smaller context, 2) bump replica count, 3) restore prefetch workers. Which is fastest?
oncall-sre: Route shift looks fastest. I'll start a canary route shift to dedicated-fallback: model-lite-1. Quantify impact.
prod-support: Notifying affected customers with ETA ~15m for mitigation.
ops-bot: runbook action: trigger route-shift to model-lite-1 [runbook: streaming-tail-latency]. Executing...
ops-bot: command: ``redwood route shift --from /v1/generate --to model-lite-1 --percent 30 --reason "p99 spike"``
ops-bot: started canary at 30% traffic to model-lite-1.
oncall-sre: After 2 min: p99 down to 1.1s on canary traffic, overall p99 dropping to ~1.8s. KV hit still low.
eng-runtime: I'll roll prefetch worker restart on one shard to see if hit-rate recovers. Doing a graceful restart.
eng-runtime: Restarted prefetch on shard-3. KV hit up to 84% on that shard, tail latency improved for instances on shard-3.
sre-lead: Good. Continue controlled restart across shards with 30s stagger. Monitor p95/p99 and SLOs.
oncall-sre: Kicking staggered restarts now.
incident-bot: Update: SLO alert status: p95 in-bounds, p99 improving but still above SLO target in EU.
prod-support: Customer message updated: we applied a fallback route and are investigating root cause, will update in 30m.
eng-runtime: Observed increased tokenization overhead on a small subset of requests (long prompt headers). Adding request histogram filter to exclude heavy outliers from autoscaling calc.
sre-lead: Action items: 1) finish restarts across shards (eng-runtime), 2) keep route-shift at 30% until p99 < 900ms for 5m (oncall-sre), 3) prepare rollback plan if route shift causes quality regress (prod-support + eng-runtime).
oncall-sre: Will maintain on-call watch for 1 hour. Handoff to next oncall at 3109994500 if stable.
customer-success: Flagged high-touch customers for follow-up once fully resolved.
eng-runtime: Creating a retrospective ticket to track prefetch worker regression and add KV cache health check to alerts.
sre-lead: Thanks team. Marking this as "mitigated" for paging but remain in monitoring. Ping me if p99 creeps up again. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation=route-shift+prefetch-restarts, impact=EU increased p99, customer-timeouts=partial, status=monitoring
prod-support: Copy. Preparing post-incident communication draft.
oncall-sre: Handoff to next oncall: @oncall-sre-next you're up in 1h, docs and links in the incident ticket.
oncall-sre: Closing live thread, continuing watch in the incident channel.
